ES: conflicto resuelto, pero el unico nivel a tiro (maximo overnight/Asia 7254.75-7261, SMT bajista) todavia no se barrio: 9 toques sin romper, tipo barrida capado en B -> WAIT. Ademas el mas estirado de los 5 (3.13 ATR).

CL: sin conflicto de marcos ni choque de tesis, el unico de los 5 totalmente limpio en contexto, pero el techo overnight/Asia 85.15-85.23 lleva 3 toques sin romper: sin barrida confirmada no hay A+ -> WAIT.

en: all 5 instruments remain in the same underlying bullish day that flipped on Nov 25; Asia and London extended the rally and the 24h move stays LONG across all 5 (NQ +1.9%, ES +1.3%, GC +2.4%, YM +1.2%, CL +4.8%).
the frame conflict that was blocking 4 of the 5 in London resolved in ES, GC and YM (the 4h stopped clashing with the 1h); only NQ still has the bullish 1h against a bearish 4h.
NQ: cleanest. An A+ PDH/London-high cluster retest 26344-26351, confluence 7; blocked only by the frame conflict -> WAIT.

ES: the conflict resolved, but the only level on tap (the overnight/Asia high 7254.75-7261, bearish SMT) hasn't been swept yet: 9 touches without breaking, a sweep type capped at B -> WAIT. Also the most stretched of the 5 (3.13 ATR).
GC: an A+ zone (a day-open/TDO cluster retest 3604.5-3621.1) but it clashes with the bullish underlying thesis (a confirmed BOS yesterday, COT longs already crowded) -> WAIT.

YM: just swept its PDH 50435 and closed back below (0 candles ago, a live rejection); the frame conflict resolved and the thesis is aligned, but the type (a sweep) caps it at B -> WAIT, watch for a second close below 50435.

CL: no frame conflict and no thesis clash, the only one of the 5 fully clean on context, but the overnight/Asia ceiling 85.15-85.23 has 3 touches without breaking: with no confirmed sweep there's no A+ -> WAIT.
